Item Class: Jewels
Rarity: Magic
Shining Small Cluster Jewel of Joy
--------
Requirements:
Level: 54
--------
Item Level: 68
--------
{ Enchant Modifier }
Adds 3 Passive Skills
(Added Passive Skills are never considered to be in Radius by other Jewels)
{ Enchant Modifier }
Added Small Passive Skills grant: +15% to Cold Resistance
--------
{ Suffix Modifier "of Joy" — Mana }
Added Small Passive Skills also grant: 5% increased Mana Regeneration Rate
{ Prefix Modifier "Shining" — Defences }
Added Small Passive Skills also grant: +4 to maximum Energy Shield
--------
Place into an allocated Small, Medium or Large Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Added passives do not interact with jewel radiuses. Right click to remove from the Socket.
